allow: Bash(printf '%s\\r\\n' '' '# ==========================================================================' '# FOLDERSYNC BASELINE EVALUATION' '# ==========================================================================' '$fsIssues = @\(\)' '' '# FolderSync-CloudBackup task: State = Ready' '$task = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName FolderSync-CloudBackup -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' 'if \(-not $task\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""FolderSync-CloudBackup task: NOT FOUND""' '} elseif \($task.State -notin @\(""Ready"",""Running""\)\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""FolderSync-CloudBackup task: State = $\($task.State\) \(expected Ready\)""' '}' '' '# FolderSync-Watchdog task: State = Ready or Running' '$wdTask = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName FolderSync-Watchdog -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' 'if \(-not $wdTask\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""FolderSync-Watchdog task: NOT FOUND""' '} elseif \($wdTask.State -notin @\(""Ready"",""Running""\)\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""FolderSync-Watchdog task: State = $\($wdTask.State\) \(expected Ready or Running\)""' '}' '' '# FolderSyncWatchdog service: Status = Running, StartType = Automatic' '$wdSvc = Get-Service -Name FolderSyncWatchdog -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' 'if \(-not $wdSvc\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""FolderSyncWatchdog service: NOT FOUND""' '} else {' '    if \($wdSvc.Status -ne ""Running""\)      { $fsIssues += ""FolderSyncWatchdog service: Status = $\($wdSvc.Status\) \(expected Running\)"" }' '    if \($wdSvc.StartType -ne ""Automatic""\) { $fsIssues += ""FolderSyncWatchdog service: StartType = $\($wdSvc.StartType\) \(expected Automatic\)"" }' '}' '' '# FolderSyncAuditor service: Status = Running, StartType = Automatic' '$audSvc = Get-Service -Name FolderSyncAuditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' 'if \(-not $audSvc\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""FolderSyncAuditor service: NOT FOUND""' '} else {' '    if \($audSvc.Status -ne ""Running""\)      { $fsIssues += ""FolderSyncAuditor service: Status = $\($audSvc.Status\) \(expected Running\)"" }' '    if \($audSvc.StartType -ne ""Automatic""\) { $fsIssues += ""FolderSyncAuditor service: StartType = $\($audSvc.StartType\) \(expected Automatic\)"" }' '}' '' '# Registry FolderSyncRealTime: non-empty' '$rtReg = Get-ItemProperty -Path HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run -Name FolderSyncRealTime -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' 'if \(-not $rtReg -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace\($rtReg.FolderSyncRealTime\)\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""Registry FolderSyncRealTime: NOT FOUND or empty""' '}' '' '# RealTimeSync process: listed' '$rtProc = Get-Process -Name RealTimeSync -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' 'if \(-not $rtProc\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""RealTimeSync process: NOT RUNNING""' '}' '' '# Rclone: returns version string' '$rclonePath = ""C:\\Tools\\Rclone\\rclone.exe""' 'if \(-not \(Test-Path -LiteralPath $rclonePath\)\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""Rclone binary: NOT FOUND at $rclonePath""' '} else {' '    $rcloneVer = & $rclonePath version 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1' '    if \($rcloneVer -notmatch ""rclone""\) {' '        $fsIssues += ""Rclone: did not return version string \(got: $rcloneVer\)""' '    }' '}' '' '# Cloud sync log today: exists' '$todayLog = ""C:\\Sync\\Logs\\cloud_sync_$\(Get-Date -Format yyyy-MM-dd\).log""' 'if \(-not \(Test-Path -LiteralPath $todayLog\)\) {' '    $fsIssues += ""Cloud sync log today: NOT FOUND \($todayLog\)""' '}')

Bash(printf '%s\\r\\n' '' '# ==========================================================================' '# CAMERA BASELINE EVALUATION' '# ==========================================================================' '$camIssues = @\(\)' '' '# Yawcam process \(yawcam or javaw\): running' '$yawProc   = Get-Process -Name yawcam -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' '$javawProc = Get-Process -Name javaw  -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' 'if \(-not $yawProc -and -not $javawProc\) {' '    $camIssues += ""Yawcam process \(yawcam or javaw\): NOT RUNNING""' '}' '' '# Monitor process \(powershell with yawcam_monitor\): running' '$monProc = Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter ""Name='"''"'powershell.exe'"''"'"" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |' '    Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match ""yawcam_monitor"" }' 'if \(-not $monProc\) {' '    $camIssues += ""Yawcam monitor process \(powershell yawcam_monitor\): NOT RUNNING""' '}' '' '# Webcam PnP device: Status = OK' '$webcam = Get-PnpDevice -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |' '    Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -match ""camera|webcam|HD User Facing"" -and $_.Class -eq ""Camera"" } |' '    Select-Object -First 1' 'if \(-not $webcam\) {' '    $camIssues += ""Webcam PnP device: NOT FOUND""' '} elseif \($webcam.Status -ne ""OK""\) {' '    $camIssues += ""Webcam PnP device: Status = $\($webcam.Status\) \(expected OK\)""' '}' '' '# Registry Yawcam: non-empty' '$yawReg = Get-ItemProperty -Path HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run -Name Yawcam -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' 'if \(-not $yawReg -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace\($yawReg.Yawcam\)\) {' '    $camIssues += ""Registry Yawcam: NOT FOUND or empty""' '}' '' '# Registry YawcamMonitor: non-empty' '$monReg = Get-ItemProperty -Path HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run -Name YawcamMonitor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue' 'if \(-not $monReg -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace\($monReg.YawcamMonitor\)\) {' '    $camIssues += ""Registry YawcamMonitor: NOT FOUND or empty""' '}')
